ABOUT VOODOO

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

TEAM

Our Gaming team is made up of hybrid-casual, casual and mid-core experts. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.

You'll join the Portfolio Games Team (PGT) within Live: a small, tech-first and AI-first team that manages and grows a catalogue of 40+ live mobile games played by millions of users worldwide, with many more titles being onboarded. We own the full lifecycle, from game health monitoring and A/B testing to ASO, release management and live operations.

To do this at portfolio scale we are building Sophia, our in-house AI agent that already manages games, runs A/B tests and automates store work across dozens of games. Our goal is simple: take humans out of the repetitive loop so the team can focus on making the product better.

ROLE

We are looking for a freelance Technical Artist to bridge art and engineering in an AI-first studio. Our development side already moves fast with Sophia; art production is now the bottleneck. Your mission is to set up the conventions, tools and pipelines that let AI generate, check and integrate 2D and 3D assets across our portfolio with minimal human intervention. By Q1 2027 we want Sophia running full art and 3D flows end to end, and you will be key to getting there.

You will work day to day with our dev lead and the engineer who owns our AI/Figma/Unity art workflows, and with the art team.

- Define art conventions and standards (naming, structure, layout rules for UI, banners and store assets) so that assets can be produced and validated automatically, not hand-polished one by one

- Build tools and scripts in art software (Maya, plus Photoshop/Illustrator where useful) that check and fix assets automatically, e.g. validating that 3D meshes are watertight, within poly budgets and correctly set up, so an AI agent can run them as part of a pipeline

- Optimise 3D models and meshes (topology, polygon count, UVs, LODs) and textures (compression, sizes, atlases) for mobile, without sacrificing visual quality

- Own the Unity import pipeline: import settings, asset post-processors and automation so assets land in our games correctly and consistently

- Integrate AI generation tools (image, 3D, animation) into production workflows and evaluate new ones as they appear

- Help scale animated assets (e.g. animated store banners and promo visuals) across many games through templates and automation rather than manual work

- Debug and fix graphical and performance issues across mobile devices; support shaders, VFX and particles where needed

Unity Ads serves billions of ad requests across hundreds of thousands of mobile games. Every one of those requests involves content on both sides: an ad creative we are about to show, and a game we are about to show it for.

Understanding that content — what is in it, who it is appropriate for, and whether it belongs on the network at all — underpins both the safety of the marketplace and its relevance. The Content Understanding and Moderation charter covers representation, turning creatives and games into signals our models can use, and enforcement, detecting and acting on content that violates policy, regulation, or advertiser and publisher expectations. These are deliberately a single charter: the same multimodal understanding that improves relevance is what makes moderation possible at scale.

The Role

We are seeking a senior machine learning engineer to define how Unity understands and moderates the content flowing through its ad network. You will work closely with a world-class modeling team to power the recommendation for billions of users, while keeping them safe from bad content.

What You’ll Do

•

Execute on the multimodal content representation strategy across video, image, playable, audio, and text, so that one set of foundations serves both relevance and moderation rather than two divergent stacks

•

Partner with product, engineering, science teams to translate regulatory and contractual obligations into objectives an ML system can be measured against

•

Define what good looks like where labels are scarce, noisy, and genuinely contested, and build the evaluation and labeling infrastructure that makes it measurable

•

Build the shared foundations other teams depend on, including content embeddings, game level features, evaluation harnesses, and labeling pipelines

What We’re Looking For

•

Experience in multimodal machine learning combining vision and language, with video experience especially relevant

•

Experience owning a trust and safety, content moderation, brand safety, or policy enforcement system in production, where being wrong in either direction carried real consequences

•

Experience operating where labels are scarce, ambiguous, or disputed, and where the definition of a violation shifts over time

•

Experience adapting foundation models for production use, including fine-tuning, distillation, and optimization for latency and cost

•

Strong programming skills in Python and experience running production ML systems on a serving path, with fluency in latency, throughput, and cost tradeoffs

•

Experience reviewing and remaining accountable for production code, including code produced with AI assistance

You might also have (optional)

•

Familiarity with regulatory and policy regimes affecting advertising content, such as DSA, child-directed treatment, and regional advertising standards

•

Strong systems thinking, with the ability to reason about performance, scalability, reliability, and cost tradeoffs in distributed systems

SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

SpaceXAI is building and operating one of the world’s most demanding AI training campuses in Memphis, including Colossus and site facilities that support it. The people who work here—and the buildings and grounds they occupy—have to keep up with that tempo.

The Sr. Manager of Facilities Maintenance owns building and grounds maintenance across the Memphis campus. This role leads a multi-layered organization of managers, supervisors, and technicians responsible for offices, industrial support buildings, and site infrastructure: work orders and preventive maintenance, building HVAC, plumbing, electrical and transformers, carpentry and building envelope, janitorial, landscaping, waste, and pest control. Facility care is a direct reflection of our values, and the impact is immense.

This is facilities maintenance, not data center facilities operations. You will not own the central utility plant, rack-level cooling, or white-space infrastructure. You will own the campus around it— air handlers that fail, transformers that need attention, grounds that have to stay presentable, leaks, and a work-order system that has to close tickets fast—so the site can operate without distraction.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Lead and develop a multi-layered organization of managers, supervisors, and technicians across the Memphis campus to deliver reliable building and grounds maintenance with minimal disruption to site operations.
• Set campus-wide strategy, budgeting (CapEx/OpEx), and resource forecasting for facilities maintenance; drive ownership of execution, safety culture, and work quality.
• Own the campus work-order and preventive maintenance programs: ticketing, staffing, response times, backlog, and closeout for break/fix and scheduled work across offices, support buildings, and grounds.
• Oversee building systems maintenance—HVAC, plumbing, electrical and transformers, fire/life safety as building systems, and general repairs—so occupied facilities stay safe, functional, and presentable.
• Own soft services across the campus, including janitorial, landscaping and grounds, waste, and pest control; manage third-party vendors to corporate standards, SLAs, and cost.
• Partner with construction, EHS, and site operations to plan and execute office, grounds, and building improvement projects without impacting ongoing operations.
• Conduct ongoing assessment of resource needs, life-cycle costs, and staffing for multiple buildings; own long-term capital planning for building and grounds assets.
• Define, track, and communicate key performance indicators (safety, response time, work-order backlog, quality, labor productivity, and operating expenses) and drive accountability across the organization.
• Provide oversight of emergency response and on-call coverage for building emergencies (leaks, HVAC failures, power issues, safety conditions); ensure a robust after-hours support model.
• Lead talent development, succession planning, and organizational design for a high-performing facilities maintenance team.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, facilities management, architecture, construction management, business, or a related field.
• 8+ years of progressive experience in facilities maintenance or building operations (offices, industrial, or campus environments), including at least 3 years leading supervisors or managers.
• Demonstrated experience leading teams responsible for work orders, preventive maintenance, building systems, and vendor-delivered soft services.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Proven track record managing budgets, capital projects, and a complex vendor ecosystem across multiple buildings.
• Experience with computerized maintenance management (CMMS) / work-order systems and building management systems for HVAC, plumbing, electrical, fire/life safety, and related building equipment.
• Knowledge of building electrical and transformers, plumbing, HVAC, and general construction/maintenance practices.
• Experience negotiating contracts and comparing service costs to achieve maximum value.
• Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate operational issues to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
• Strong leadership presence with a track record of building high-performing teams and delivering results in a fast-paced, high-tempo environment.
• Highly organized, self-driven leader capable of operating with significant autonomy while aligning to company priorities.
• Experience managing large-scale work under aggressive timelines with frequent changes in scope and priority.
• Proficiency in Microsoft applications such as Excel, Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Based at the Memphis, TN campus; travel across the site as needed and occasionally to other xAI or SpaceX locations.
• Must be able to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed.
• Ability to provide 24/7 on-call support for building emergencies and critical facility issues.
• Comfort operating in a high-stress, high-tempo environment while balancing multiple priorities and rapidly adapting to changing business needs.

In this role, we: Review architectural designs and requirements for new features introduced to the product Drive the design, development, and execution of tests across functional, performance, and security scopes as part of SW GA and update releases Develop Python automation suites built on clean OOP principles Chase down defects and validate fixes until we fully resolve the root cause Leverage the SimX platform to validate code and debug the ASIC long before hardware arrives What We Need to See: Combined network engineering depth with thorough software habits 5+ years of hands-on QA or networking experience, backed by CCNP-equivalent protocol knowledge: L2 (VLAN, STP), L3 (BGP, OSPF), EVPN, VXLAN, and advanced features like PFC, ECN, RoCE, and QoS Production-quality Python engineering—specifically, strong OOP design and hands-on experience with Pytest Deep Linux proficiency (at an LPIC-1 or LPIC-2 level) to navigate system internals, analyze logs, and debug effectively Clear verbal and written communication, with professional proficiency in written and spoken English B.Sc. or or B.A. or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a similar background Ways to stand out from the crowd: Experience with Docker and traffic generation tools (Ixia, TRex, Scapy) Hands-on experience integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI) Working knowledge of virtualization platforms (KVM, VMware)

jobs.description: Amazon continues to invest in its Advertising business, and Publisher Technologies builds the services and data capabilities that enable Amazon’s first party publishers to improve customer experiences and monetize their inventory. The Publisher Technology Data, Insights, and Analytics team provides the near real time data, analytics, reporting, and data management tools used by hundreds of teams across Amazon to understand advertising performance, make business decisions, and support machine learning at scale. As a Business Intelligence Engineer II, you will design and own analytical solutions that turn large, complex datasets into actionable insights. You will build data models, ETL pipelines, dashboards, metrics, and reporting tools while working across engineering, science, product, and business teams. You will investigate performance trends, establish reliable measurement frameworks, and design experiments that improve publisher and advertiser experiences. You will own mid to large scale BI solutions, often starting with loosely defined business problems and translating them into clear analytical approaches and deliverables. The role requires strong SQL, data modeling, visualization, and analytical skills, along with the ability to understand data lineage, identify the business context behind metrics, and communicate findings that influence product and business decisions. Key job responsibilities - Design, build, and maintain BI solutions including data models, ETL workflows, dashboards, and reports that serve your team and its stakeholders, ensuring solutions are testable, performant, and well-documented. - Collaborate with business partners and technical teams to refine ambiguous problems into specific deliverables, recommend alternatives, and anticipate future analytical needs based on a deep understanding of the business context. - Apply SQL expertise and data engineering best practices to extract, transform, and load data at scale, while optimizing query performance and minimizing resource usage across the team's data infrastructure. - Create compelling data visualizations and self-service reporting tools that enable stakeholders to interpret results independently and make informed decisions quickly. - Mentor peers on the team's BI architecture and data lineage, contribute to design and scoping discussions, and apply basic statistical methods to support analytical rigor in solving business problems. A day in the life You start your morning reviewing a stakeholder request for a new metric, working through the data lineage to understand how upstream systems generate the underlying signals. After refining the requirements in a quick sync with your business partner, you spend focused time writing SQL and building a new data model. In the afternoon, you pair with a teammate to review a dashboard prototype, offer feedback on visualization choices, and wrap up by documenting your design decisions for the broader team. About the team Our team is focused on delivering trusted, high-quality business intelligence that empowers partners across the organization to make better decisions. We build and maintain analytical solutions that connect data from multiple sources into clear, reliable insights our customers depend on every day. We value collaboration, technical craft, and a shared commitment to getting the details right. As we continue to scale our capabilities, you will play a key role in shaping how we approach data architecture and analytics for the years ahead.
